commands.name: dataviz
commands.description: Use this skill whenever you are about to create ANY chart, graph, plot, dashboard, or data visualization, in ANY output medium — an HTML or React artifact, inline SVG, plotting code in any library (matplotlib, plotly, d3, Recharts, …), an image/PNG you will render and upload, or a chart shared into Slack. Read it BEFORE writing the first line of chart code, choosing chart colors, building a stat tile / meter / KPI row, or laying out a dashboard. Produces visualizations that read as one system — elegant, accessible, consistent in light and dark — using a brand-neutral placeholder palette you swap for your own. Teaches a design-system-agnostic method: a form heuristic, a color formula with a runnable validator, mark specs, and interaction rules. A validated default palette is documented in `references/palette.md` — swap that file's values for your brand's. Triggers on: "chart", "graph", "plot", "data viz", "visualization", "dashboard", "analytics", "visualize data", "categorical colors", "sequential / diverging palette", "stat tile", "sparkline", "heatmap", "legend", "axis", "tooltip", "chart colors", "color by series".

commands.name: update-config
commands.description: Use this skill to configure the Claude Code harness via settings.json. Automated behaviors ("from now on when X", "each time X", "whenever X", "before/after X") require hooks configured in settings.json - the harness executes these, not Claude, so memory/preferences cannot fulfill them. Also use for: permissions ("allow X", "add permission", "move permission to"), env vars ("set X=Y"), hook troubleshooting, or any changes to settings.json/settings.local.json files. Examples: "allow npm commands", "add bq permission to global settings", "move permission to user settings", "set DEBUG=true", "when claude stops show X". For simple settings like theme/model, suggest the /config command.

commands.name: verify
commands.description: Verify that a code change actually does what it's supposed to by exercising it end-to-end and observing behavior — drive the affected flow, not just tests or typecheck. Run before committing nontrivial changes; bootstraps this repo's project verify skill if none exists yet. Don't invoke it on a diff that only touches tests, docs, or other code with no runtime surface to drive (a change to product source always has one) — there's nothing to observe.

478	// current v7 typed shape, replicating the Node `moduleMusicMigrationSchema`
479	// preprocess followed by the `moduleMusicSchema` zod defaults:
480	//
481	//   - v4 → v5: `blocked_commands: string[]` becomes, for each listed command,
482	//     `commands[cmd].enabled = false` (the rest of the entry defaults:
483	//     use_global all-true, access `all_except []` on every axis), merging into
484	//     any pre-existing `commands` map. `blocked_commands` is dropped. When there
485	//     is NO `commands` key and NO blocked list, `commands` defaults to the full
486	//     `MUSIC_COMMANDS` set (every command enabled).
487	//   - legacy `use_global: boolean` (music's original v5, pre-b4f57ff) expands to
488	//     the per-axis `{roles, channels, categories}` object per command.
489	//   - `commands_global` defaults to unrestricted (`all_except []`) when absent.
490	//   - v7: `audio_quality` absent (every pre-v7 doc) → "default".
491	//   - stamps `schema_version = 7` (SchemaVersionMusic).
492	//
493	// It overlays present raw leaves onto the defaults (never trusting Go's
494	// zero-value for an absent leaf — a legacy `{enabled:false}` entry still gets
495	// `use_global` all-true), so the result matches Node's zod-with-defaults
496	// field-for-field. Idempotent: a doc already in v7 shape round-trips unchanged.
497	func MigrateMusicRaw(raw bson.M) ModuleMusic {
498		var m ModuleMusic
499		// Base decode of the STABLE fields (everything except the command-access
500		// maps, which need overlay-onto-default semantics and can carry a legacy
501		// boolean `use_global` that would not decode into the struct).
502		if b, err := bson.Marshal(stripMusicCommandKeys(raw)); err == nil {
503			_ = bson.Unmarshal(b, &m)
504		}
505	
506		m.CommandsGlobal = musicAccessFromRaw(raw["commands_global"])
507		m.Commands = musicCommandsFromRaw(raw["commands"], raw["blocked_commands"])
508		// v7: `audio_quality` is absent in every pre-v7 doc — stamp the zod
509		// default instead of trusting the zero value.
510		if m.AudioQuality == "" {
511			m.AudioQuality = MusicAudioQualityDefault
512		}
513		// v8: `auto_delete_commands` needs a PRESENCE check, not a value check.
514		// An empty list is a legitimate configuration ("clean nothing"), so the
515		// decoded value alone cannot tell "the admin emptied it" from "the field
516		// never existed" — the trick used above for `audio_quality` (where `""` is
517		// an impossible sentinel) has no equivalent here. Only the raw document
518		// knows, so this is the one place the default can be seeded safely.
519		if _, ok := raw["auto_delete_commands"]; !ok {
520			m.AutoDeleteCommands = append([]string(nil), MusicAutoDeleteCommandsDefault...)
521		}
